cast.name: 内尔吉巴特尔·那桑巴雅尔 Nerguibaatar Nasanbayar

writer.name: 巴勒金尼玛·贝格兹 B. Baljinniam

introduction: A disabled girl named Alyonor comes with her mother to Hankha, a port town at the northern end of Lake Khuvsgul.They live in a wooden house by the lake next to Galar, a laborer who loads and unloads ships. He is a cheerful and good-natured man, but he has a single-minded disposition and hates crookedness. He clashes with people wherever he goes and loses his job, which causes his wife and child to run away from him.Galar realizes that the reason Alyonor's leg is not getting better is because of her mental state, so he tries to get her to turn her back on herself and get out of the house.Meanwhile, the bosses who control the loading and unloading of ships are skimming Galar and his family's salaries. Galar storms into the office, but is kicked out instead.Galar asks a friend to make a wheelchair for Alyonor.Thanks to his devotion, Alyona's heart gradually opens up to him, but in return, Galar is abandoned by the head of the shipping dock, whom he trusted, and feels cornered.On his next payday, Galar becomes angry when he sees that his salary has been increased to keep him quiet, and he storms into the office yelling again, losing his job once again.On top of that, he is taken to Hatgal, a port town south of the lake, on suspicion of assault. He lies to Alyona that he is going to take a dump truck training course, but she scolds him for the lie. The two had come to see each other as inseparable. Alyona's feelings for Galar finally make her stand up.
